birth.child: Your child's birth month and year

errors.too_young: TapStrong is for ages 9 and up.
errors.ask_parent: Kids under 13 need a parent or guardian to set up TapStrong. Ask a parent to help you.
errors.guardian_consent: Kids under 13 need a parent's consent first. Kids' profiles are set up from the Family plan, which arrives in a later update.
errors.child_too_old: This option is for kids under 18. Adults can set up their own profile.
errors.parent_too_young: Check the birth year. This option is for parents and grandparents.

who.footnote: We use your age only to keep training safe for you.

chat.title: Coach interview

questions.goals: What's your main goal? Pick one or more.
questions.schedule: Where do you train, how long, and how often?
questions.focus: What do you want to improve?
questions.body: Which body model fits you? Height and weight are optional; I use them to pick the model closest to you.
questions.bodyChild: Which body model should we show?

chat.focusMarked: I marked it on your body map: {{list}}.
chat.focusDeferred: No problem. You'll tap the muscles on the body map next.
chat.notUnderstood: I didn't quite get that. Pick from the options, or try other words.
chat.understood: Got it. Check the options below and continue.

safety.name: Safety check
safety.title: Anything we should work around?
safety.noteOk: Great. You can always add pain or injuries later, or tap “I feel pain” during a workout.
safety.redFlagBody: Some of your answers mean you should check with your doctor before your first workout. You can still set up your plan now.
safety.footnote: TapStrong adapts training; it doesn't give medical advice.

profile.title: Your plan, at a glance
profile.goalsNone: You'll pick muscles on the body map next

notes.bodyFat: A softer look is often partly body fat, so your plan adds a short cardio finisher and a 4-week check-in.
notes.senior: Balance work and seated or supported options come first, with more recovery between hard days.
notes.redFlag: Check with your doctor before your first workout.

bodyMap.title: Tap a muscle
bodyMap.subtitle: Matched to your age · change body or age anytime
bodyMap.hint: Tap a dot to select. Front and back for every body.
bodyMap.none: No areas yet. Tap a dot on the body.
bodyMap.chipHint: Tap a chip to change its goal

march_in_place.name: March in place
march_in_place.cues: Lift your knees at an easy pace and swing your arms.

seated_march.name: Seated march
seated_march.cues: Sit tall and lift one knee, then the other, at an easy pace.

jumping_jacks.name: Jumping jacks
jumping_jacks.cues: Jump feet apart as arms go up, then back together. Land softly.

brisk_walk.name: Brisk walk
brisk_walk.cues: Walk at a pace where you can still talk.

arm_circles.name: Arm circles
arm_circles.cues: Draw slow circles with straight arms, forward then back.

band_pull_apart.name: Band pull-apart
band_pull_apart.cues: Hold the band at chest height and pull it apart, squeezing your shoulder blades.

leg_swings.name: Leg swings
leg_swings.cues: Hold a support and swing one leg forward and back, relaxed.

hip_circles.name: Hip circles
hip_circles.cues: Hands on hips, draw slow circles with your hips both ways.

cat_cow.name: Cat-cow
cat_cow.cues: On hands and knees, round your back, then gently arch it.

torso_twist.name: Torso twist
torso_twist.cues: Turn your upper body side to side, hips facing forward.

push_up.name: Push-up
push_up.cues: Body in a straight line; lower your chest to the floor and press up.

wall_push_up.name: Wall push-up
wall_push_up.cues: Hands on a wall at chest height; bend your elbows and push back.

feet_elevated_push_up.name: Feet-elevated push-up
feet_elevated_push_up.cues: Feet on a bench, body straight; lower your chest and press up.

incline_dumbbell_press.name: Incline dumbbell press 30°
incline_dumbbell_press.cues: Elbows at 45°. Lower to the upper chest, press up and in slightly.

flat_dumbbell_press.name: Flat dumbbell press
flat_dumbbell_press.cues: Lower the dumbbells beside your chest and press up.

low_to_high_cable_fly.name: Low-to-high cable fly
low_to_high_cable_fly.cues: Bring the handles up and together in an arc to eye level.

high_to_low_cable_fly.name: High-to-low cable fly
high_to_low_cable_fly.cues: Bring the handles down and together in front of your hips.

seated_chest_press_machine.name: Seated chest press machine
seated_chest_press_machine.cues: Back on the pad; press the handles forward and return slowly.

dumbbell_shoulder_press.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell_shoulder_press.cues: Press the dumbbells overhead without arching your back.

band_front_raise.name: Band front raise
band_front_raise.cues: Raise straight arms to shoulder height and lower slowly.

band_face_pull.name: Band face pull
band_face_pull.cues: Pull the band toward your face, elbows high and out.

one_arm_dumbbell_row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
one_arm_dumbbell_row.cues: Hand on the bench; pull the dumbbell to your hip.

band_row.name: Band row
band_row.cues: Pull the band to your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat_pulldown.cues: Pull the bar to your upper chest, chest up.

seated_cable_row.name: Seated cable row
seated_cable_row.cues: Sit tall and pull the handle to your belly.

dumbbell_shrug.name: Dumbbell shrug
dumbbell_shrug.cues: Lift your shoulders toward your ears, pause, lower.

superman.name: Superman
superman.cues: Lying face down, lift arms and legs a little, then lower.

bird_dog.name: Bird dog
bird_dog.cues: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long.

dumbbell_curl.name: Dumbbell curl
dumbbell_curl.cues: Elbows by your sides; curl up and lower slowly.

band_curl.name: Band curl
band_curl.cues: Stand on the band and curl your hands to your shoulders.

overhead_dumbbell_triceps_extension.name: Overhead triceps extension
overhead_dumbbell_triceps_extension.cues: Hold a dumbbell overhead; lower behind your head and extend.

bench_dip.name: Bench dip
bench_dip.cues: Hands on the bench behind you; bend your elbows and press up.

band_triceps_pushdown.name: Band triceps pushdown
band_triceps_pushdown.cues: Elbows fixed at your sides; push the band down.

dumbbell_wrist_curl.name: Dumbbell wrist curl
dumbbell_wrist_curl.cues: Forearms on your thighs; curl the dumbbells with your wrists.

plank.name: Plank
plank.cues: Elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line. Breathe.

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
dead_bug.cues: On your back, lower the opposite arm and leg, low back down.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.cues: Knees bent; curl your shoulders off the floor, then lower.

reverse_crunch.name: Reverse crunch
reverse_crunch.cues: On your back, curl your knees toward your chest.

side_plank.name: Side plank
side_plank.cues: On one elbow, lift your hips into a straight line.

band_pallof_press.name: Band Pallof press
band_pallof_press.cues: Band at your side; press it straight out and resist the twist.

bodyweight_squat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweight_squat.cues: Sit back and down, knees over toes, then stand.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet_squat.cues: Hold a dumbbell at your chest; squat down and stand tall.

sit_to_stand.name: Sit to stand
sit_to_stand.cues: From a chair, stand up without using your hands, then sit slowly.

reverse_lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse_lunge.cues: Step back and lower both knees, then return.

leg_press.name: Leg press
leg_press.cues: Feet hip-width; lower with control and press away.

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute_bridge.cues: On your back, drive through your heels and lift your hips.

dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.cues: Soft knees; hinge at the hips, dumbbells close to your legs.

lying_hamstring_curl_machine.name: Lying hamstring curl
lying_hamstring_curl_machine.cues: Curl your heels toward your glutes and lower slowly.

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing calf raise
standing_calf_raise.cues: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower slowly.

seated_knee_raise.name: Seated knee raise
seated_knee_raise.cues: Sit tall and lift one knee toward your chest.

side_lying_adductor_raise.name: Side-lying inner thigh raise
side_lying_adductor_raise.cues: Lying on your side, lift the bottom leg a little.

wall_tibialis_raise.name: Wall tibialis raise
wall_tibialis_raise.cues: Back on a wall, lift your toes up and lower.

band_terminal_knee_extension.name: Band knee extension
band_terminal_knee_extension.cues: Band behind your knee; straighten the knee against it.

step_up.name: Step-up
step_up.cues: Step onto the bench, stand tall, step down with control.

single_leg_balance.name: Single-leg balance
single_leg_balance.cues: Stand on one leg; hold a support if you need it.

mountain_climber.name: Mountain climber
mountain_climber.cues: In a plank, drive your knees in, one after the other.

doorway_chest_stretch.name: Doorway chest stretch
doorway_chest_stretch.cues: Forearm on a door frame; lean forward gently.

cross_body_shoulder_stretch.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cross_body_shoulder_stretch.cues: Pull one arm across your chest with the other.

overhead_triceps_stretch.name: Overhead triceps stretch
overhead_triceps_stretch.cues: Hand behind your head; gently press the elbow.

standing_quad_stretch.name: Standing quad stretch
standing_quad_stretch.cues: Hold a support; pull your heel toward your glute.

seated_hamstring_stretch.name: Seated hamstring stretch
seated_hamstring_stretch.cues: Leg straight; lean forward from the hips.

seated_figure_four_stretch.name: Seated figure-four stretch
seated_figure_four_stretch.cues: Ankle over the other knee; lean forward gently.

wall_calf_stretch.name: Wall calf stretch
wall_calf_stretch.cues: Hands on a wall, back leg straight, heel down.

childs_pose.name: Child's pose
childs_pose.cues: Sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward.

kneeling_hip_flexor_stretch.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
kneeling_hip_flexor_stretch.cues: One knee down; shift your hips forward gently.

upper_trap_stretch.name: Upper trap stretch
upper_trap_stretch.cues: Tilt your ear toward your shoulder; relax.

standing_side_stretch.name: Side stretch
standing_side_stretch.cues: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the side.

hug_upper_back_stretch.name: Upper back hug stretch
hug_upper_back_stretch.cues: Hug yourself and round your upper back.

biceps_wall_stretch.name: Biceps wall stretch
biceps_wall_stretch.cues: Palm on a wall behind you; turn away slowly.

box_breathing.name: Slow breathing
box_breathing.cues: Breathe in for 4, hold 4, out for 4, hold 4.

neutral_grip_floor_press.name: Neutral-grip floor press
neutral_grip_floor_press.cues: Lie on the floor, palms facing each other; lower until your upper arms touch the floor, then press up.

neutral_grip_machine_chest_press.name: Neutral-grip machine chest press
neutral_grip_machine_chest_press.cues: Palms facing in, handles at mid-chest; press out without locking your elbows, stop before your hands pass your chest on the way back.

short_range_incline_push_up.name: Short-range incline push-up
short_range_incline_push_up.cues: Hands on a bench, body straight; lower only halfway, then push back up.

workout.draftBadge: Development build: draft exercises, not reviewed yet. They never reach users.
workout.demoPending: The demo video arrives with the licensed exercise library.

swap.title: Instead of {{name}}
swap.empty: No safe alternative for this muscle with your equipment.
swap.remainingOnly: Sets you already logged stay as they are; the swap covers the remaining sets.

player.warmupShorten: Loaded work today: you can shorten the warm-up, not skip it.
player.skipCooldownConfirm: Skip cool-down? It helps you recover and counts toward your streak.
player.progressUp: Top of the range twice in a row: the load goes up a step.
player.progressHold: Keep this load until the reps feel solid.

pain.title: Where does it hurt?
pain.stopBody: Sharp pain means stop. We'll save what you did. If it doesn't settle, check with a doctor.
pain.suggested: Suggested swap · same muscle, spares your {{area}}
pain.tiredBody: Tired is normal. Take a longer rest, then finish the set with good form.

exit.title: End workout?
exit.body: You've done {{done}} of {{total}} sets. We'll save them and color the muscles you worked. Your streak still counts.
exit.bodyEmpty: Nothing is logged yet. Keep going, or discard this workout.

legend.fade: Red fades as muscles recover: orange after 1 day, peach after 2, neutral after about 72 h.
legend.fadeSenior: Red fades as muscles recover: orange after 1 day, peach after 2, neutral after about 96 h.

finish.never: Your {{group}} haven't been trained yet. Add a 10-minute finisher now, or put them first next time?
finish.stale: Your {{group}} haven't been trained in 5+ days. Add a 10-minute finisher now, or put them first next time?
finish.saved: Done: your {{group}} go first next time.

account.streakSaverDetail: One nudge at {{time}} if you haven't moved
account.permissionDenied: Notifications are off for TapStrong. Turn them on in your phone's settings.
account.under13: Under 13? A parent or guardian creates your profile from their Family plan.
account.terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy. TapStrong is not medical advice.

errors.full_other: The Family plan holds up to {{count}} profiles.
errors.needFamily: Family members need the Family plan.
errors.needCharge: Profiles for children under 13 open after your first Family payment. The free trial doesn't count: the payment is how we verify a parent's consent.

consent.title: Parent consent
consent.intro: Before {{name}} can train, please read how TapStrong handles a child's information.

points.collect: We store only what the workouts need: birth month and year, body map goals, safety answers, and workout logs. No photos, no body measurements.
points.use: We use it only to build safe workouts for a child's age. No ads, no social sharing, no open chat with the coach.
points.never: We never sell it or share it with anyone.
points.rights: You can see, change or delete your child's profile at any time, from this phone.

consent.verification: Your paid Family subscription in the App Store or Google Play confirms you are an adult with a payment method. This is how we verify a parent's consent.
consent.agree: I am the parent or legal guardian and I agree

errors.not_charged: We couldn't confirm a paid Family plan yet. It can take a few minutes after the first payment.
errors.offline: Can't reach TapStrong right now. Check your connection and try again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.body: This deletes your account and all its data on our servers: your profile, family profiles you manage, workouts, restrictions and streaks. It also clears this phone. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.bodyLocal: You don't have a saved account, so your data lives only on this phone. This deletes it: profiles, workouts, restrictions and streaks. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.storeBody: Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription. Apple and Google only let you cancel in your store subscriptions, so cancel there first to avoid being charged.

errors.offline: Can't reach TapStrong right now. Nothing was deleted. Try again when you're online.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Nothing was deleted. Try again.
